pages.title: Homeo India — India's Community for Homeopathic Doctors & BHMS Students
pages.description: An independent academic and professional community connecting homoeopathic practitioners, students, interns and researchers across India. Discuss cases, find mentors, join webinars and share research.
content: Homeo India is an independent academic and professional community connecting homoeopathic practitioners, students, interns and researchers across India.
Behind every good homeopath are a hundred others who helped. Be one of the hundred.
Membership categories: Registered Practitioner, BHMS Student, Intern, Qualified Graduate and Academic / Research Member.
Registered-practitioner status is shown only after checking applicable professional registration records.
Homeo India is not a government authority, statutory medical council, licensing body or medical registration authority.

pages.title: About Homeo India — Our Mission for Indian Homeopathy
pages.description: Homeo India is an independent platform for academic learning, professional networking and knowledge sharing in homoeopathy. Read how verification works.
content: HomeoIndia is an independent platform created to facilitate academic learning, professional networking, educational discussions and knowledge sharing within the homoeopathic community.
HomeoIndia reviews the academic and professional information submitted by members. Registered-practitioner status is displayed only after checking applicable professional registration records.
HomeoIndia is not a government authority, statutory medical council, licensing body or medical registration authority.

pages.title: Who Can Join Homeo India — Homeopathic Doctors & BHMS Students
pages.description: Homeo India is open to registered practitioners, BHMS students, interns, qualified graduates and academic members aged 18+. See what each category needs.
content: Five membership categories: Registered Practitioner, BHMS Student, Intern, Qualified Graduate (registration pending) and Academic / Research Member.
Each category is verified differently. A degree does not by itself mean a person is registered to practise.
